highlights: The AI model landscape continues its rapid expansion with Mistral AI launching a massive 1.05T multimodal MoE model and OpenAI introducing a cost-effective, high-intelligence GPT-6.1 Sol for professional workloads.
Significant progress in AI agent development includes OpenAI's 'dots' for proactive assistance, alongside critical research for auditing black-box agents and teaching reliable coding capabilities.

Key developments in the ecosystem focus on enhancing developer accessibility and regulatory compliance, notably with Together AI's CLI for integrating open models into proprietary environments and OpenAI's framework for EU text provenance rules.

agents.title: OpenAI Introduces 'dots': Proactive AI Assistants for Complex Projects
agents.summary: OpenAI unveils 'dots,' a new category of proactive AI assistants designed to manage complex projects and everyday tasks, allowing users to maintain control while automating workflows.

agents.title: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with Surrogate Log-Probabilities
agents.summary: A novel, training-free framework called Proxy Confidence is introduced to audit black-box LLM agents by using a low-cost open-weight surrogate, significantly improving error detection and driving more accurate agent actions at lower cost.

agents.title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
agents.summary: New research demonstrates how to teach autonomous coding agents to reliably resolve repository issues by improving search direction, edit diversity, and verification processes, achieving higher success rates on benchmarks like SWE-bench Verified.

models.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
models.summary: Mistral AI's public preview of 'Le Chonk,' a 1.05 trillion parameter multimodal Mixture of Experts model with a 1 million token context window, sets a new benchmark for open-weight models with native image input.

models.title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6.1 Sol: Near-Astra Intelligence at Lower Cost
models.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Sol, a highly intelligent model designed for coding, computer use, and professional tasks, offering near-Astra capabilities at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API token prices.

models.title: Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2: A 740M Open Multimodal Embedding Model
models.summary: Google DeepMind launched EmbeddingGemma 2, an open 740M multimodal embedding model that maps five input types into a unified 768-dimensional space, providing a versatile tool for developers under an Apache 2.0 license.

tools.title: Together Link: Free CLI to Run Open Models in Proprietary Code Editors
tools.summary: Together AI's new MIT-licensed CLI, Together Link, allows developers to integrate open-source models like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 directly into proprietary coding environments such as Claude Code and Codex, potentially reducing inference costs by over 50%.

tools.title: ROAR: Unifying Runs Across Heterogeneous AI Research Systems
tools.summary: ROAR is introduced as the first infrastructure designed to unify and analyze outputs from diverse AI-driven research systems, providing a relational schema and parsing layer to normalize data, enabling large-scale analytics and revealing problem landscape properties.

tools.title: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents
tools.summary: AutoSynthData offers a solution for generating high-quality training data for enterprise agents, addressing a critical need for developing robust and specialized AI applications within corporate environments.

companies.title: Atlassian and OpenAI Expand Partnership for Enterprise Knowledge
companies.summary: Atlassian and OpenAI are deepening their partnership to leverage frontier models with enterprise knowledge, empowering teams to streamline planning, building, and delivery of work within organizational contexts.

companies.title: OpenAI's Approach to EU Text Provenance Rules
companies.summary: OpenAI outlines its strategy for implementing text watermarking under new EU regulations, detailing where watermarks apply, how detection works, and prioritizing researcher access to ensure compliance and promote responsible AI development.

companies.title: REAL Rating: A Framework for Disclosing Human-AI Collaboration
companies.summary: The REAL Rating framework introduces a six-tier scale for transparently disclosing the extent of AI involvement in both content creation and user experience across various media, providing a clear standard beyond binary categorizations for human-AI collaboration.

learning.title: A Model Guide for the GPT-6 Family: Optimizing AI Workflows for Startups
learning.summary: OpenAI provides a comprehensive guide for startups on effectively utilizing GPT-6 models, covering model selection, prompt engineering, skill integration, tool coordination, and preparing AI workflows for production environments.

learning.title: OpenAI Partners with SBDC to Bring AI Training to Small Businesses
learning.summary: OpenAI is partnering with America's SBDC to deliver hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, enabling them to integrate AI effectively into their operations and foster growth.

learning.title: DevFest is Back: Global Developer Events for the Agentic AI Era
learning.summary: DevFest 2026 returns with over 800 global events, offering developers opportunities to connect, build, secure, and scale AI applications, particularly focusing on the agentic AI era.
